about: Timeline — things across time, in lanes: spans (a start and an end) and milestones (a single point), on one scale. Use for: how several threads ran side by side and overlapped (eras, a project's phase

map.Name: Timeline data
map.State: Passed: runtime, not a prop, Current: runtime, not a prop

label.about: What the timeline shows. Names it for assistive technology.

start.about: The first and last points of the scale.

step.about: Distance between ticks on the axis, in the scale's units.

format.about: How a point on the scale is written: a year as itself, a day as a date.

datetime.about: The machine-readable date for a point, when it is one (a time element's datetime: "1996", "2026-03-14"). Left out, whole years from 1000 to 9999 are dates and anything else (a week number, a fraction

words.ts: { milestones?: string; periods?: string; to?: string; }
words.about: The words the timeline says for itself, for a page in another language.

view.about: The part of the scale in view. Defaults to all of it; narrow it to zoom, move it to pan.

now.about: A point marked with a line across every lane ("today").

nowLabel.about: The words for the now line.

variant.about: How it is drawn. "lanes" (the default): a Gantt chart, one row per lane. "journey": one line that travels the scale, its milestones as dots along it (the current one unfolding into a callout: its year

reveal.about: How far along the scale the story has got. The journey's line is drawn to here; milestones and periods emerge as it reaches them, and periods grow behind it. A registered number, so moving it is a tra

tell.about: In a journey, how far the current milestone has been told, 0 to 1: its dot lands, its stem draws, its rule runs out, then its year, name and detail arrive. Leave it out and becoming current is a trans

pairWith.Timeline.Show today: now (omit it to hide the today line)
pairWith.TimelineJourney.Period: the current lane's label in lanes
pairWith.TimelineJourney.Earlier period: an earlier lane's label in lanes
pairWith.TimelineJourney.Show periods: lanes (one lane shows no period labels)
pairWith.Timeline/Item.Kind: lanes[n].items[m]: a span has an end, a milestone does not
pairWith.Timeline/Milestone.Type: the milestone's detail content: code, text or media

omit.Timeline.Detail title: runtime: the detail shows whichever moment the person selects
omit.Timeline.Detail when: runtime: the detail shows whichever moment the person selects
omit.Timeline.Detail: runtime: the detail shows whichever moment the person selects
omit.Timeline.Show detail: runtime: the detail opens on selection
omit.TimelineJourney.Show passed: derived: moments before now draw as passed
omit.TimelineJourney.Side: layout: the journey alternates sides by itself
